newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: INTERVIEW - MobileOne in S$50 mln network upgrade.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - MobileOne in S$50 mln network upgrade.

text.p: MobileOne (Asia) Pte Ltd (M1), Singapore's second mobile phone player, said on Thursday overwhelming demand for its three week-old service had forced it to accelerate its Singapore $360 million investment programme.

"We've had to accelerate our investment programme and can confirm a S$50 million investment in network expansion and customer service expansion," chief executive Neil Montefiore told Reuters in an interview.
"This is bringing forward the expansions that were planned for the next year," he added.
Montefiore said M1 had attracted 35,000 subscribers in its first three weeks.
He said this was "way beyond our expectations", and had put unexpected pressure on network capacity.

The pressure was evident on Tuesday when subscribers found themselves unable to receive calls originating from fixed-line services in Singapore. Engineers worked around the clock to correct the problem, Montefiore said.
M1 is a joint venture of Singapore Press Holdings, Keppel Telecom, Britain's Cable & Wireless and Hong Kong Telecommunications.
The company began operations on April 1, offering rival handphone service to the former monopoly Singapore Telecommunications Ltd.
